subject.title: 3.9.6 fails to launch on macOS 15: missing @rpath/libswiftCompatibilitySpan.dylib

question: Should the project issue an immediate replacement/hotfix for v3.9.6 after validating a static-link versus bundled-runtime packaging fix on clean macOS 15?
rationale: The source identifies a missing release-artifact verification boundary, but the choice of static runtime linkage or a bundled signed dylib affects notarization, artifact layout, and the urgency/shape of a release response.

options.title: Ship a validated hotfix
options.body: Prefer static linkage where toolchain-supported, otherwise ship a signed and notarized dylib bundle with matching Homebrew packaging and clean-host smoke proof.

options.title: Bundle the runtime explicitly
options.body: Keep dynamic linkage but change the archive and formula to install the signed compatibility dylib beside the executable, with upgrade documentation.

options.title: Pause distribution change
options.body: Keep the report open while confirming the loader failure independently before replacing the current release artifact.

recommendation.title: Ship a validated hotfix
recommendation.body: Prefer static linkage where toolchain-supported, otherwise ship a signed and notarized dylib bundle with matching Homebrew packaging and clean-host smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The v3.9.6 release metadata identifies this person as the releaser for the affected signed distribution.
